crypto.msp_note: Drunix (HLF 2.5.x fork); Lite Peer endorses, Committing Peer validates+commits

caveats: drunix ran on YugabyteDB (its shipped test-network default); LevelDB parity is unavailable, so the state-DB variable is NOT held constant vs fabric-cft for this run

drunix write values are JSON-wrapped client-side to survive a YugabyteDB statedb bug (non-JSON values panic the Committing Peer); the on-wire payload format differs from the shared kv workload on other platforms for this run
state-db parity not held: run requested leveldb, platform actually ran yugabyte
no sweep step held (failure <= 2.0%, goodput >= 95%, send-gap p99 <= 50 ms); hold ran at the probe rate (10 TPS) and the headline is a floor, not a saturation figure
